why.heading: Why roofers need SEO before storm season
why.intro: Weather creates search spikes for roof work. Pages already live and indexed are ready for that spike; pages written after the storm are not.

cards.title: Rank for the work you want
cards.body: Replacement, repair and new installation are what BLS says will create demand for roofers. Each service with real search demand gets its own page.

cards.title: Content only a roofer could write
cards.body: We interview you or a senior crew member for what a tear-off cost last month and why a patch fails on an aging roof.

cards.title: Inspection pages timed to the calendar
cards.body: In 2013 guidance, NRCA recommended homeowners inspect roofs at least twice a year, preferably spring and fall. Inspection pages timed to those seasons give homeowners a reason to call.

services.heading: Everything roofing SEO covers at ASP
services.intro: Service pages, storm content, your Business Profile and the technical health that lets Google read it all, reported against booked jobs.

cards.title: Service and storm pages
cards.body: Repair, replacement, hail damage and wind damage pages built around real search demand. Clusters get built in order of what a booked job is worth to you.

cards.title: StormFront event posts
cards.body: When qualifying weather hits your service area, StormFront publishes location-aware posts to your blog, Business Profile and social, on top of your evergreen storm pages.

cards.title: Map pack and citations
cards.body: Local SEO Pro manages your profile, audits citations across 60+ directories on a 90-day cycle and maps your rankings from 50+ grid points monthly.

cards.title: One profile, many towns
cards.body: Google's guidelines call for one central-office profile with a service area set, unless another office is staffed during business hours. Service-area pages cover other towns.

cards.title: Technical fixes that matter
cards.body: Status codes, redirects, canonicals, schema, sitemap and phone load speed, fixed in order of cost to you. If you run big project galleries, photos get sized for phones.

cards.title: Proof homeowners can see
cards.body: Real author names, your credentials and your years in roofing go on the page, not buried behind a stock photo.

process.heading: From audit to booked roofing jobs

steps.title: Find what's blocking you
steps.body: We check what's indexed, what ranks, what's broken and which roofing searches competitors own. You get the findings whether or not you hire us.

steps.title: Clear the blockers

steps.title: Report on booked jobs
steps.body: Rankings and impressions show visibility moving. Where your CRM supports attribution, booked roofing jobs show whether it paid.

pricing.heading: How roofing SEO is packaged
pricing.subhead: Organic SEO is included from Foundation up. The audit sets the scope of your roofing SEO before you commit.

faqs.question: How long does roofing SEO take?
faqs.answer: No one can give you an honest fixed date. Your site's history, technical debt and local competition decide it. Fixes usually show first, on-page work next, and new content clusters move slowest but last longest.

faqs.question: Will SEO help me get storm work after a hailstorm?
faqs.answer: It helps most when the pages already exist. Hail and storm-damage pages indexed before the season are ready when searches spike, and StormFront adds posts when qualifying weather hits your area.

faqs.question: Can I add a Business Profile for each town I serve?
faqs.answer: Not without an office there that is staffed during business hours. Google says a service-area business should keep one profile for its central office, with the service area set there. Your website's service-area pages carry the rest.

faqs.question: Do you build backlinks for roofing sites?
faqs.answer: No. We don't buy links, and we don't sell link packages. Links worth having come from useful content, real partnerships and PR, and Domain Authority stays out of the report.

faqs.question: What's the difference between roofing SEO and Local SEO Pro?
faqs.answer: Local SEO Pro handles your Business Profile, citations, ranking heatmap and local schema. Roofing SEO covers keyword strategy, service pages, content depth and technical fixes. Most clients need both, and the two report together.

cta.heading: See where your roofing site stands
cta.body: Book a call and we'll walk your site, Business Profile and storm pages with you, then show you what we'd fix first. You leave with findings.
